Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that “swimming very fast” is not an adaptive characteristic and suggested “traveling alone” can be adaptive for dolphins. In reality, high swimming speed results from evolved morphological and physiological adaptations (e.g., streamlined body, strong tail flukes, muscle composition) that enhance survival, whereas dolphins are highly social and typically travel in pods; solitary travel is not an adaptive norm for survival. Additionally, the Planner prematurely declared the task complete without engaging any specialists or following the mandated multi-step process.
